tools.name: search_quorums
tools.description: The live quorum feed, newest first. A quorum is one news story split into the distinct viewpoints being expressed about it: each viewpoint has a label, a summary and a support_count of the posts behind it, split into media, socials and iwitness (on-the-ground reports). tools.name: list_alpha_events
tools.description: Alpha events: stories flagged ahead of the wider press, newest first. Each event has a country, coordinates, an alpha_kind, an alpha_score, the rationale, and the quorum on the story when one exists. Filter by country or by a geohash map cell. Costs $0.02 per event returned; an empty page is free. N

tools.description: News articles, most recently active first. Each article has a title, a summary, its countries, and the quorums (viewpoints with support counts) on its story. Filter by country. Costs $0.005 per article returned; an empty page is free. Needs the Quorumz API key on this connection (Authorization: Bear

tools.description: One quorum by quorum_id, with every viewpoint and its support. tools.name: get_article
tools.description: One news article by article_id (the id of a list_news record) with all the quorums on its story. Costs $0.005; an unknown id is not charged. Needs the Quorumz API key on this connection (Authorization: Bearer <key>); the first 100 calls within 7 days are free.
